elements.name: Alchemist
elements.desc: An Alchemist is an expert at combining reagents to produce mystical effects.

elements.name: Alchemist Tool Proficiency
elements.desc: When you adopt this specialization at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with alchemist's supplies.

elements.name: Alchemist Spells
elements.desc: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain spells prepared.

elements.name: Experimental Elixir
elements.desc: Beginning at 3rd level, whenever you finish a long rest, you can magically produce an experimental elixir.

elements.name: Alchemical Savant
elements.desc: At 5th level, you develop masterful command of magical chemicals.

elements.name: Restorative Reagents
elements.desc: Starting at 9th level, you can incorporate restorative reagents into some of your works.

elements.name: Chemical Mastery
elements.desc: By 15th level, you have been exposed to so many chemicals that they pose little risk to you.

elements.name: Artillerist
elements.desc: An Artillerist specializes in using magic to hurl energy, projectiles, and explosions.

elements.name: Artillerist Tool Proficiency
elements.desc: When you adopt this specialization at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with woodcarver's tools.

elements.name: Artillerist Spells
elements.desc: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain spells prepared.

elements.name: Eldritch Cannon
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you learn how to create a magical cannon.

elements.name: Arcane Firearm
elements.desc: At 5th level, you know how to turn a wand, staff, or rod into an arcane firearm.

elements.name: Explosive Cannon
elements.desc: Starting at 9th level, every eldritch cannon you create is more destructive.

elements.name: Fortified Position
elements.desc: Starting at 15th level, you're a master at forming well-defended emplacements using Eldritch Cannon.

elements.name: Battle Smith
elements.desc: A combination of protector and medic, a Battle Smith is an expert at defending others and repairing both material and personnel.

elements.name: Battle Smith Tool Proficiency
elements.desc: When you adopt this specialization at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with smith's tools.

elements.name: Battle Smith Spells
elements.desc: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain spells prepared.

elements.name: Battle Ready
elements.desc: When you reach 3rd level, your combat training and your experiments with magic have paid off.

elements.name: Steel Defender
elements.desc: By 3rd level, your tinkering has borne you a faithful companion, a steel defender.

elements.name: Extra Attack
elements.desc: Starting at 5th level, you can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

elements.name: Arcane Jolt
elements.desc: At 9th level, you learn new ways to channel arcane energy to harm or heal.

elements.name: Improved Defender
elements.desc: At 15th level, your Arcane jolt and steel defender become more powerful.
